title: Prefill Sentinel & Model Reconciler: certainty-threshold routing and graceful fallback
creator: Ava Patel
description: Introduce a lightweight runtime component (Prefill Sentinel) that computes a kernel-fit and attention-signature based certainty score during prefill, and a Model Reconciler that uses those scores to pick a speculative decode target and orchestrate a safe fallback. Goal: reduce end-to-end latency for short-completion requests by enabling speculative decode to higher-throughput kernels/quantized variants while keeping fallback rate <= 3% and no customer-visible correctness regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel emits a per-request certainty_score (0.0-1.0) derived from kernel-fit, attention-energy-profile, and sequence-length priors
Model Reconciler chooses a speculative target model variant based on certainty_score and routing policy within 800us median decision latency
Fallback path triggers automatically when acceptance metric < routing threshold or when decoder reports kernel incompatibility
End-to-end latency improvement >= 15% p50 for targeted short requests compared to baseline (no speculative decode)
Fallback rate <= 3% on production-like synthetic workload and no measurable quality regression on validation prompt set
tasks: Design sentinel feature set (kernel-fit heuristics, attention signature extractor)
Implement in-runtime lightweight extractor (C++ kernel hooks + small Rust/Go shim)
Model Reconciler service (stateless) with policy table and confidence thresholds
Add telemetry: counters for accept/reject, decision latency, fallback reason tags
Create end-to-end integration test and loadbench scenario
Run staged rollout: sandbox -> canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full with auto-rollback metric checks
Documentation: API for certainty_score, config knobs, ops runbook
comments: 2026-03-02 - Ava Patel: Initial spike complete. Kernel-fit metric candidates: normalized kernel latency delta, token-wise KV miss ratio, and attention energy variance. Draft proposal in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/ENG-537221-prefill-sentinel-proposal

2026-03-04 - Diego Morales: Implemented prototype extractor in the sandbox runtime (branch: github.com/redwood/rt/compare/feat/prefill-sentinel). See PR: https://github.com/redwood/rt/pull/6123 — performance microbench attached to the PR.

2026-03-06 - Priya Nair (Review): Reviewed the kernel hooks. Concern: computing attention-energy variance adds 30us per prefill on A100. Recommendation: sample every Nth head and amortize across requests. Filed follow-up task ENG-537222.

2026-03-08 - Diego Morales: Reconciler policy table prototype added. Decision latency median 560us in local bench. Telemetry events keyed: sentinel.score, reconciler.decision_ms, fallback.reason.[kernel|metric|decode-error]. Dashboard draft: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/serving/prefill-sentinel

2026-03-09 - Elena Kowalski (PM): Updated acceptance thresholds. Proposed initial routing policy: if certainty_score >= 0.82 -> route to fast-quantized variant; 0.6-0.82 -> route to medium variant; <0.6 -> no speculative decode. PM requested A/B to validate quality impact.

2026-03-10 - Diego Morales: Integration test added. Loadbench shows 18% p50 latency improvement on short requests with 2.7% fallback rate. Triggering staged canary in sandbox for further validation. Ops runbook draft in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1PrefillSentinelOps
